[RAOT.2.1] One `CompiledCode` atom per compiled function (one per alpha, beta or terminal
node).  The body proto is defined in `proto/aot.proto`
as `CompiledCode`.

```
arch:    string    — architecture identifier (IAOT.1)
node_id: uint32    — the alpha, beta or terminal node this implements
kind:    CodeKind  — ALPHA_TEST | JOIN_TEST | RHS
body:    bytes     — slot table (zero-filled) followed by machine code
```
